observations.name: wrapped-firstLastGraphBimodalClassPrefix
observations.query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

observations.name: e-generic-ordinary
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20

observations.name: e-generic-distinct
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20

observations.name: b-ordinary-skip
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12

observations.name: b-distinct-skip
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id AS missing, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12

observations.name: b-ordinary-order-parallel
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY name, id SKIP 2 LIMIT 12

observations.name: b-ordinary-order-generic-serial
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-android-00' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id DESC SKIP 2 LIMIT 12

observations.name: b-distinct-order-retained
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller ORDER BY caller SKIP 0 LIMIT 2

observations.name: b-distinct-order-eviction-candidate
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY n.callee_name DESC SKIP 0 LIMIT 2

observations.name: b-order-duplicate-alias-ties
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.caller_name AS x, n.callee_name AS x ORDER BY x SKIP 2 LIMIT 8

observations.name: b-distinct-order-callee
observations.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS name ORDER BY name DESC, callee SKIP 1 LIMIT 3
